tasks.label: Docs: Playwright Procedure Walkthrough
tasks.detail: Walks a doc's numbered procedure in a real browser against the Dev stack, capturing screenshots at each new UI state. See TEAM_HANDOFF_GUIDE.md Step 4.5.

tasks.label: Docs: Apply Captured Screenshots
tasks.detail: Uploads the screenshots from the last walkthrough run to CS-Docs Sandbox and splices them into the doc.

inputs.description: Path (repo-relative) to the new/updated .md file, e.g. cs-docs/studio/my-new-feature.md

Dev/staging stack URL for the feature being documented, if you have one specific to this PR. Leave blank to use dev11 (you'll pick the org/stack manually when the browser pauses) — paste a Sandbox URL here explicitly if you want that instead.
